prompt: Create a highly detailed cinematic anime illustration titled EIRUNE | MORNING APERTURE: a white-haired young woman standing on a high apartment balcony at sunrise, holding a steaming mug with both hands and gazing upward in quiet wonder as the city literally opens the sky. She has short tousled silver-white hair, pale skin, soft gray-blue eyes, a calm morning expression, small earrings, and a futuristic circular blue hair ornament with dangling black tassels near one ear. Her outfit is an oversized dark charcoal hooded jacket over a pale shirt and long muted skirt, wind slightly lifting the fabric. The balcony is cluttered but cozy, with metal railings, potted green plants, a small bench or outdoor furniture, pipes, cables, industrial apartment fixtures, and a sleeping cat on the left side. Beyond her is a dense futuristic waterfront city at golden hour: layered mid-rise buildings, elevated rail tracks, a yellow-and-white commuter train crossing the scene, bridges, harbor water, distant skyscrapers, haze, and warm sunbeams. Above the skyline, enormous segmented orbital megastructure panels curve across the sky like mechanical shutters or petals opening, with exposed dark framework, panel seams, bolts, weathering, and gaps revealing a bright blue sky with scattered clouds; the sun sits low near the opened aperture, casting radiant shafts of light and lens-like glow through the structure. Use an ultra-polished Japanese sci-fi slice-of-life style, intricate background detail, realistic atmospheric perspective, soft rim lighting, volumetric morning light, subtle film grain, delicate linework, painterly realism, and a hopeful contemplative mood. Include exactly 4 visible sign/text elements integrated into the environment: 1) a vertical white fabric banner on the left reading 「おはよう」 with a simple cat face drawing below it, 2) a small white sign on the lower left reading “A Better Morning Ahead.”, 3) a tower sign on the right reading “KAZE MIRAI CITY”, and 4) a large dark wall billboard on the lower right with Japanese text and the English line “SAME SKY, A BRIGHTER DAY.” Keep the composition vertical, portrait orientation, character in the lower-left foreground, city sweeping into the middle distance, giant sky aperture dominating the upper half, no extra characters, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一幅高度精细的电影感动漫插画，标题为 EIRUNE | MORNING APERTURE：一位白发少女在日出时分站在高层公寓阳台上，双手捧着冒热气的马克杯，静静地仰望天空，看着城市上方的天空缓缓开启。她留着凌乱的银白色短发，皮肤白皙，有着柔和的灰蓝色眼眸，表情宁静，佩戴着小耳环，耳边有一个带有黑色流苏的未来感圆形蓝色发饰。她身穿一件超大号深炭灰色连帽外套，内搭浅色衬衫和长款素色裙子，微风轻轻拂动衣角。阳台杂乱而温馨，配有金属栏杆、盆栽绿植、小长椅或户外家具、管道、电缆、工业风公寓设施，左侧还有一只正在睡觉的猫。在她身后是黄金时刻的密集未来感滨水城市：层叠的中高层建筑、高架轨道、穿过场景的黄白相间通勤列车、桥梁、港口水域、远处的摩天大楼、薄雾和温暖的阳光。天际线上方，巨大的分段式轨道巨型结构面板像机械百叶窗或花瓣一样在天空中弯曲开启，露出深色的框架、面板接缝、螺栓、风化痕迹，缝隙间透出带有零星云朵的湛蓝天空；太阳位于开启的光圈附近，投射出放射状的光束，并透过结构形成镜头般的光晕。采用超精致的日本科幻生活片段风格，背景细节繁复，具有真实的空气透视感，柔和的轮廓光，体积感晨光，细腻的胶片颗粒，精致的线条，绘画般的写实感，以及充满希望的沉思氛围。在环境中集成 4 个清晰可见的标志/文字元素：1) 左侧垂直的白色布质横幅，写着「おはよう」，下方绘有一个简单的猫脸；2) 左下方的一个小白牌，写着“A Better Morning Ahead.”；3) 右侧的塔式标志，写着“KAZE MIRAI CITY”；4) 右下方的一块大型深色墙面广告牌，上面有日语文字和英文短语“SAME SKY, A BRIGHTER DAY.”。保持构图为竖构图，肖像方向，人物位于左下角前景，城市延伸至中景，巨大的天空光圈占据上半部分，不要添加额外角色，不要添加水印。
